region: Compare before and after a fix
editorHint: Write the change you want to try, for example CREATE INDEX. It is applied inside a transaction and rolled back, so your data stays the same.
idle: Nothing has been run yet. Enter a change and press Run to see the query before and after it.
empty: Enter a change to try first.
stale: The change was edited after this result. Press Run to update it.

delta.fewer: Pages read: {before} before, {after} after, {diff} fewer in this scenario.
delta.more: Pages read: {before} before, {after} after, {diff} more in this scenario.
delta.same: Pages read: {before} before and {after} after, no difference in this scenario.

rowsChanged: The results are no longer equivalent. The query returned {before} rows before the change and {after} rows after it, so the page counts are not comparable like for like.
rowsNotCompared: Row counts are not compared because the measured query is not a SELECT.

failed.timeout: The engine took too long and was stopped. The change was not kept.
failed.worker_crashed: The engine stopped. Reload the page or rebuild the session, then run again.
failed.load_failed: The engine could not be loaded.
failed.unknown: The run failed for an unexpected reason.
